messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: latency.p99 > 1.2s for service 'inference-api' (eu-west). Alert ID: alert-78321

pagerduty: PagerDuty event created -> PD-INC-4729. Routing: primary oncall (alyssa_oncall).

alyssa_oncall: acked PD-INC-4729 :thumbsup:

alyssa_oncall: seeing continuous p95 ~480ms but p99 spikes to ~1.6-2.1s on EU regional fleet. Noticed around 18:05 UTC.

samir_sre: joining. Any customer-facing errors?

jess_prod: no 5xxs reported from frontend, just request latency upstream. Some customers reported slowed chat responses (support tickets 3241,3243).

mike_infra: pulling autoscaler graphs now. Initial glance: EU dedicated pool CPU on the head nodes is normal, but GPU utilization shows sudden batching spike on a subset of hosts. Could be a hotkey or KV cache miss storm.

alyssa_oncall: grabbing logs from the tail. Running quick query:

```
SELECT count(*) as calls, avg(latency_ms) as avg_ms, p99(latency_ms) as p99_ms
FROM requests
WHERE region = 'eu-west' AND time > now() - interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY shard
ORDER BY p99_ms DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

alyssa_oncall: top offending shard shows p99 ~2100ms, throughput only modestly increased. KV cache eviction rate spiked at 18:03 UTC.

samir_sre: suggests possible cache thrash from recent rollout? Any canary or model variant rollout in EU?

jess_prod: no active rollouts in EU. We did push a minor reroute config to prefer quantized variants in us-west earlier, but not EU.

mike_infra: checking router logs -> I see elevated small-batch counts and a backlog on the serving-side queue. Looks like many tiny requests prevented efficient batching, causing head-of-line delays.

alyssa_oncall: mitigation proposal: 1) temporarily enable fallback-routing to standby smaller model variant in eu-west for non-SLA customers, 2) bump per-request batching window from 5ms -> 10ms for the affected shards, 3) kick off manual warmup of KV cache on top 5 hot shards. Thoughts?

samir_sre: +1 on warming cache and bumping batching window. Need to coordinate with product for fallback routing flags.

jess_prod: can toggle fallback flag for 'low-priority' customer cohort now. Doing it -> toggled :white_check_mark:. Monitoring for impact.

mike_infra: applying batching window change to shard-group eu-2-*-serving (rolling patch):

```
kubectl -n serving set env deploy/sidecar BATCH_WINDOW_MS=10 --context=eu-2
```

mike_infra: rolled to 3/5 pods, will continue.

alyssa_oncall: warming KV cache (manual replay) started on shard eu-2-a, eu-2-b. Script: `scripts/warm_kv.sh --shard eu-2-a --lookback 30m`

incident-bot: :hourglass: Automated actions: fallback routing enabled for cohort 'beta', batching parameter change initiated, cache-warm tasks queued.

alyssa_oncall: after first 120s, p99 on shards patched dropped from 2100ms -> 950ms. Overall region p99 reduced from ~1.8s -> ~1.1s. Still above SLO but improving.

samir_sre: good signal. Will keep an eye on queue depth and backpressure metrics. If we see rethrottle, consider temporarily limiting low-priority concurrency (rate-limit).

emma_support: flagged impacted customers: 6 chats slowed, 2 support tickets escalated to Priority P2. Noting that critical enterprise customers unaffected so far.

alyssa_oncall: taking ownership to continue mitigation until steady for 15m. If p99 remains >1.2s, we'll escalate to PD rotation for deeper debugging.

pagerduty: PD-INC-4729 status: acknowledged by alyssa_oncall at 18:08 UTC.

mike_infra: completed rollout to 5/5 pods for batching window. New steady-state p95 ~420ms, p99 ~820ms. Queue length normalized.

jess_prod: fallback routing removed (traffic moved back) for beta cohort after metrics stable.

alyssa_oncall: marking this as hotspot mitigation complete, will monitor 30m. Summary for incident record: automated page triggered by p99 spike likely due to KV-cache eviction + request pattern causing many tiny batches. Mitigations: fallback routing for low-priority cohort, increased batching window, manual KV warmup. Customer impact: minor slowdowns for small set of beta users; no widespread outage.

samir_sre: recommend a follow-up runbook update: detect KV eviction storms and apply automated transient batching-window increase + auto-warm. Filing ticket INFRA-1292.

emma_support: I will send a short note to the affected customers with a brief explanation and that mitigation applied.

alyssa_oncall: thanks team. Closing PD incident if metrics stay stable for next 30m. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PD-INC-4729 closed by alyssa_oncall at 18:28 UTC (auto-close after stable window).
